cves.description: Advanced PoC & Research for CVE-2026-0828 (Safetica) and CVE-2025-7771 (ThrottleStop). Analysis of BYOVD (Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver) TTPs for Ring 0 process termination and physical memory R/W. Researching EDR-Killer patterns, PPL bypasses, and kernel-mode primitives used by MedusaLocker and other threat actors.
